column3: |city.name| – Enforcers are looking into a string of deaths that sources say bear the hallmarks of a contract killer. Nobody has claimed responsibility and no motive links the victims.\r\n\r\nResidents are advised to lock their doors and report anyone asking unusual questions about their neighbours.
ENFORCERS CLOSE IN ON CONTRACT KILLER

|city.name| – A task force has been set up to hunt the contract killer behind the recent deaths. Witnesses are being questioned and several addresses are under watch.\r\n\r\n'It is only a matter of time,' a spokesperson said. 'Somebody always talks.'

|city.name| – A warrant has been issued for the contract killer terrorising the city. Enforcers are authorised to use lethal force on sight.\r\n\r\nWord on the street is that the underworld has put a price on the killer's head too: too much attention is bad for business.
This is the precinct. Write this number down.
Police. We have a few questions for you.
